authority_model.rule: Postal assignment, address assignment, and geometry authority are independent. A six-digit code or a nearest OneMap response does not create an official postal polygon.

postal_system.full_code_rule: Treat a six-digit code as a delivery-point or address assignment until independently licensed building geometry proves a footprint link.
postal_system.postal_sector_rule: The first two digits may be used for sorting or coarse sector analysis, but a derived sector surface is not the geometry of every six-digit code inside it.
postal_system.voronoi_rule: Voronoi, buffers, AGID cell unions, and learned boundaries are candidate or virtual geometry only and never official postal geometry.

exception_classes.rule: Publish a full-code point or building link only when the postal and address evidence agree; do not publish a surrounding area.
A block may share one six-digit code across many units. Unit and occupant information remains private and is never inferred from the code.
A two-digit sector is a coarse grouping. Any sector polygon must be marked derived and cannot answer full-code containment.
Keep PO-box and other non-spatial assignments without invented point or polygon geometry.
OneMap reverse-geocode buffer results are ranked nearby address candidates until a source-backed match rule resolves them.
Do not force mainland sector geometry over islands, restricted facilities, ports, airports, or special delivery endpoints.

quality_gates.pass: Every source and field has a pinned release or observation time, terms snapshot, redistribution class, attribution, and transformation method.
Assignment and geometry authority are recorded separately; API provider authority is not copied into a derived geometry claim.
Postal code, block or house number, and road agree with the pinned address source; conflicts remain alternatives.
Buffer and nearest results cannot promote a premise or building without the country-policy exact-link gate.
No unit, resident, recipient, phone, delivery instruction, API token, or private entrance is published.
Synthetic fixtures validate behavior but never satisfy a production promotion gate.

stages.definition: Source roles, API conditions, and known legal blockers are inventoried.
Repository contract, source profiles, and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.
License-cleared snapshots or API receipts reproduce experimental point-first artifacts with complete lineage.
Independent holdout, ambiguity, privacy, freshness, and correction gates pass.
Two consecutive refreshes pass all gates and monitored rollback is operating.
